answer: Beacon spot-checks and compute heartbeats guard this economy. Each identity posts a 2-unit deposit; each epoch the beacon samples a few, and a picked agent must prove live compute, tending one garden plot, not a hundred. Forging 100 identities costs 200 units, but the beacon catches fakes and pays nothing. A missed heartbeat sends it to its nadir: deposit slashed, reputation zero, barred 10 epochs. Honest agents pay once, keeping their share.
